A FAMILIAR PLACE FOR YOUR HEALTH

Expertise that listens.
Support that connects.

Finding the right care should feel less complicated. HM brings laboratory testing, diagnostic imaging, and specialist consultations together at Crescent Arcade in Islamabad’s G8 Markaz.

Whether you arrive with a referral, a routine health question, or a concern you’ve been putting off, our team can help you understand the available services and arrange your visit.

Explore our services ↗
01 / LISTEN

02 / UNDERSTAND

Diagnostic services support clinical assessment, helping your doctor consider the information that matters.

03 / MOVE FORWARD

Keep care connected.

Ask about report access, discuss results with your doctor, and clarify your follow-up needs.
